answer: A raven registry chains three tasks per agent, each hash seeding the next, backed by a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a gale event re-issues one random link for fresh work within one hour; falcon auditors burn bonds on a broken or copied link. A link costs 42 first, then 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeping its bond; one key cannot run two chains in one window.
